candidats.description: Main entrance of the LVM building, Münster , North Rhine-Westphalia , Germany The origins of today’s LVM campus date back to 1967, when the company moved into its premises on Kolde-Ring at the corner of Weseler Straße. The campus’s seven insurance buildings are located south of Münster city center. The northern part of Von-Stauffenberg-Straße runs through the campus, while Sperlichstraße forms its southern boundary. The LVM buildings were constructed between 1965 and 2014. It is to connect the stub of State Highway 20 in the south from Mt Roskill to join up with another motorway, State Highway 16 in the west at Point Chevalier, and is a part of the Western Ring Route.
